4-mark.question: अथ तयोः निश्चयं ज्ञात्वा अनागतविधाता निष्क्रान्तः सहपरिजनेन | द्वौ इमौ तत्रेव जलाशये स्थितौ | अपरेघुः धिवरैः आगत्यः जलाशये जालं क्षिप्तम | जालेन बद्धः प्रत्प्युत्पन्नमतिः मृतवद् आत्मानं संदशर्य स्थितः | ततो जालाद् अपसारित: यथाशक्ति उत्पलुत्य गंम्भिरं निरं प्रविष्टः | यभ्द्विष्य: धिवरैः प्राप्तः व्यापादितः च |

अथ तेषां तत्कुलिशोपमं वचनं समाकर्ण्य मत्स्या परस्परं प्राहुः – श्रुतोऽयम् धिवरालापः | अधुना अस्माभिः किं कर्तव्यम् ?  तत्र अनागतविधाता नाम मत्स्यः प्राह –  नूनं प्रभातसमये धीवराः अत्रागम्य मत्स्य्संक्षयं करिष्यन्ति इति मम मनसि वर्तते | तन्न युक्तं सांप्रतं क्षणमपि अत्र अवस्थातुम् |अस्माभिः रात्रौ एव किश्चित समीपं सरः गन्तव्यम् | अहं तावत् जलाशयान्तरं गच्छामि |

पुरा एकस्मिन् जलाशये अनागतविधाता , प्रत्युत्पन्न्मतिः , यभ्दविष्यश्चेति त्रयो मत्स्याः वसन्ति स्म | अथ कदाचित् तं जलाशयं दृष्ट्वा धीवरैः उक्तम् -  अहो बहुमत्स्योड़यं ह्रद: | कदाचिद् अपि न अस्माभि : अन्वेषितः | तदद्य आहारवृति : सञ्जाता | श्वः अत्रागम्य मत्स्यकूर्मादयो व्यापादयितव्या : इति निश्चयः |
ततो यभ्द्विष्येण उक्तम् –  धिवराणां वचनमात्रेण पितृपैतामहिकस्य जलाशयस्य त्यागः न युज्यते | यदि आयुः क्षयोडस्ति तदा अन्यत्र गतानामपि मृत्युः भविष्यति एव | उक्तं च
अपरः प्रतुत्पन्न्मतिः प्राह –  भविष्यदर्थे प्रमाणाभावात् कुत्र मया गन्तव्यम् | तदुत्पन्ने यथाकार्यं तद्नुद्नुष्ठेयम | तथा चोक्तम् - उत्त्पन्नामापदं यस्तु समाधते स बुद्धिमान् |

धृतराष्ट्रः एहि एहि पुत्र घटोत्कच:- अहो कल्याणः खलु अत्रभवान् | कल्याणानां प्रसूतिं पितामहमाह भगवान् चक्रायुधः l धृतराष्ट्रः – (आसनात् उत्थाय ) किमाज्ञापयति भगवान चक्रायुधः | घटोत्कच: - न न न | आसनस्थेन एव भवता श्रोतव्यो जनार्दनस्य सन्देशः |

दुर्योधनः – दूतः खलु भवान् प्राप्तो न त्वं युद्रार्थभागत: | गृहीत्वा गच्छ सन्देशं न वयं दुतघा तकाः || घटोत्कचः -(सरोषम् ) किं दूत इति मां प्रधर्षयसि | मा तावत् भो ! न दूतोडहम् | प्रहरध्वं समाहताः | ( सर्वे उतिष्ठन्ति |)

शकुनि : - यदि स्या द्वा क्यमा त्रेण नि र्जि तेयं वसुन्धरा वा क्ये वा क्ये यदि भवेत्सर्वक्षत्रवधः कृतः ॥ घटो त्कचः - शकुनि रेष व्या हरति । भोः शकुने ! अक्षा न् वि मुच्य भव बा णयो ग्यः । दुर्यो धनः – भो भोः प्रकृतिं गतः । वयमपि खलु रौ द्राः रा क्षसो ग्रस्वभा वाः ।   घटो त्कचः - शा न्तम् पा पम् शा न्तम् पा पम्। रा क्षसेभ्यो ऽपि भवन्त एव क्रूरतराः । कुतः -    न तु जतुगृहे सुप्ता न् भ्रा तृन् दहन्ति नि शा चराः    शि रसि न तथा भ्रा तुः पत्नीं स्पृशन्ति नि शा चराः ॥

धृतराष्ट यदाज्ञापयति भगवान् चक्रायुध उपविशति घटोत्कच पितामह  श्रूयताम् हा वत्स  अभिमन्यो  हा वत्स  फुरुकुलप्रदीप  हा वत्स  यदुकुलप्रवाल तव जननीं मातुलं मामपि परित्यज्य पितामहं द्रष्टुमाशया स्वर्गमभिगतोऽसि  पितामह एकपुत्रविनाशात्    अर्जुनस्य तावत् ईदृशी खलु अवस्था  का पुनर्भवतो भविष्यति  तत क्षिप्रम् इदानीम्    आत्मबलाधानं कुरुष्व  यथा ते पुत्रशोकसमुत्थितोऽग्निर्न दहेत्प्राणमयं हविरिति

4-marks.question:
तण्डुलान सम्प्राप्य सा तुषान् भुषाणानां मार्जनार्थ स्वर्णकाराय विक्रेतुं धात्रीम् अकथयत् | तस्मात् यत् धनं मिलति ,
 तेन काष्ठानि आहर इति च धात्रीम् निवेदितवति | ततः सा बुध्धिमति कन्या तान् शालिन् प्रथमम् आतपे तप्तवति | 
 ततः समायां परिशुध्धायां भूमौ तान् अघटटयत् | अनेन तुषेभ्यस्तण्डुला : पृथक् सज्जाताः |

काञ्चीनगरे शक्तिकुमारो नाम एकः श्रेष्ठिपुत्रः प्रतिवसति स्म | स यदा स्वकीयस्य जीवनस्य द्वाविंशतितमे वर्षे प्रविष्टस्तदा चिन्तामापन्नः - नास्ति दारविहीनानाम् अननुरुपगुणदाराणां च सुखम् | तत्कथं गुणवतीं भार्याम् अहं विन्देयमिति |

सम्पन्ने आहारे सा कन्या धात्रिमुखेन अतिथये प्रथमं स्नातुं निवेदितवति | ततः स्नानशुध्धाय तस्मै अतिथये सा पेयोपाहारपुर्वं भोजनं धृतसहितम् ओदनं व्यज्जनच्च अयच्छत् | एकदा स कावेरीतीरपत्तने समागतः । अत्र सः कूपे विरलभूषणां कुमारीमेकाम् अपश्यत्। तस्याः रूपसम्पदाभिभूतः सोऽचिन्तयत् -आकृष्टं मे हृदयम् अस्याम् । तदेतां परीक्ष्य विवाहप्रस्तावं कृत्वा , सत्याम् सम्मतौ उद्वहामि ।

मध्ये मध्ये सा भोज्यादीनां विविधानां पदार्थानां वर्णनं कृत्वा अतिथेः भोजनरुचिमपि अवर्धयत् । भुक्ते तु तस्मिन् अतिथौ तया ताम्बूलस्यापि व्यवस्था कृता । एवं स्वकीयया गुणसम्पदा प्रस्थपरिमितेन धान्येन विविधानि व्यञ्जनानि विरचितवतीं कन्यां प्रति समाकृष्टः शक्तिकुमारः विवाहस्य प्रस्तावं कृतवान् । कन्यया स्वीकृते प्रस्तावे तां विधिवदुपयम्य स्वनगरमनयत् ।

નરસિંહ મહેતાની બે આત્મચરિત્રાત્મક કૃતિઓનાં નામ લખો.
નરસિંહ મહેતાએ ક્યા ક્યા વિષયો પર પદો લખ્યાં છે?
લોકકંઠે વસીને કોનાં પ્રભાતિયાં ચિરંજીવ બન્યાં છે?
નરસિંહ મહેતાએ પ્રભાતિયાં માટે ક્યો છંદ વાપર્યો છે?
નરસિંહ મહેતાનું 'જળકમળ છાંડી જાને' કાવ્ય પ્રભાતિયું છે કે પદ?
નરસિંહ મહેતાએ લખેલાં પ્રભાતિયાંમાંથી બેનાં નામ લખો.
'અખિલ બ્રહ્માંડમાં' કૃતિનું નામ જણાવો.
'અખિલ બ્રહ્માંડમાં' કૃતિનું સાહિત્યસ્વરૂપ જણાવો.

અસંગત વિકલ્પ પસંદ કરો.

P અને R માટે યોગ્ય જોડાણ શોધો:

Public deposits serve as a vital financial resource for companies to meet their short-term working capital needs. These deposits, accepted for terms ranging from six to thirty-six months, provide fixed interest to depositors. Though advantageous due to lower costs and ease of obtaining funds, public deposits carry risks for depositors and pose challenges for newer or struggling companies, especially during economic downturns. The government imposes regulations to safeguard depositor interests, ensuring that companies manage these funds responsibly.

In a school, there are 1000 students, out of which 430 are girls. It is known that of 430, 10% of the girls study in class XII. What is the probability that a student chosen randomly studies in Class XII given that the chosen student is a girl?
A die is thrown three times. Events A and B are defined as below: A: 4 on the third throw B: 6 on the first and 5 on the second throw. Find the probability of A given that B has already occurred.
A die is thrown twice and the sum of the numbers appearing is observed to be 6. What is the conditional probability that the number 4 has appeared at least once?

Consider the experiment of tossing a coin. If the coin shows head, toss it again but if it shows tail, then throw a die. Find the conditional probability of the event that the die shows a number greater than 4 given that there is at least one tail.
An urn contains 10 black and 5 white balls. Two balls are drawn from the urn one after the other without replacement. What is the probability that both drawn balls are black?
Three cards are drawn successively, without replacement from a pack of 52 well shuffled cards. What is the probability that first two cards are kings and the third card drawn is an ace?
A die is thrown. If E is the event 'the number appearing is a multiple of 3' and F is the event 'the number appearing is even', then find whether E and F are independent.
An unbiased die is thrown twice. Let the event A be 'odd number on the first throw' and B be the event 'odd number on the second throw'. Check the independence of the events A and B.

Three coins are tossed simultaneously. Consider the event E 'three heads or three tails', F 'at least two heads' and G 'at most two heads'. Of the pairs (E, F), (E, G) and (F, G), which are independent? Which are dependent?
Prove that if E and F are independent events, then so are the events E and F'.
If A and B are two independent events, then the probability of occurrence of at least one of A and B is given by 1 - P(A') P(B').
Given that E and F are events such that P(E) = 0.6, P(F) = 0.3 and P(E ∩ F) = 0.2, find P(E | F) and P(F | E).
Compute P(A | B), if P(B) = 0.5 and P(A ∩ B) = 0.32.
If P(A) = 0.8, P(B) = 0.5 and P(B | A) = 0.4, find (i) P(A ∩ B), (ii) P(A | B), (iii) P(A ∪ B).
Evaluate P(A ∪ B), if 2P(A) = P(B) = 5/13 and P(A | B) = 2/5.
If P(A) = 6/11, P(B) = 5/11 and P(A ∪ B) = 7/11, find (i) P(A ∩ B), (ii) P(A | B), (iii) P(B | A).
A coin is tossed three times, where (i) E: head on third toss, F: heads on first two tosses. (ii) E: at least two heads, F: at most two heads. (iii) E: at most two tails, F: at least one tail.
Two coins are tossed once, where (i) E: tail appears on one coin, F: one coin shows head. (ii) E: no tail appears, F: no head appears.
Mother, father and son line up at random for a family picture. E: son on one end, F: father in middle. Find P(E|F).

A black and a red die are rolled. (a) Find the conditional probability of obtaining a sum greater than 9, given that the black die resulted in a 5. (b) Find the conditional probability of obtaining the sum 8, given that the red die resulted in a number less than 4.
A fair die is rolled. Consider events E = {1, 3, 5}, F = {2, 3} and G = {2, 3, 4, 5}. Find (i) P(E ∩ F) and P(F ∩ E), (ii) P(E ∩ G) and P(G ∩ E), (iii) P((E ∪ F) | G) and P(E ∩ F | G).

Assume that each born child is equally likely to be a boy or a girl. If a family has two children, what is the conditional probability that both are girls given that (i) the youngest is a girl, (ii) at least one is a girl?

An instructor has a question bank consisting of 300 easy True/False questions, 200 difficult True/False questions, 500 easy multiple choice questions and 400 difficult multiple choice questions. If a question is selected at random from the question bank, what is the probability that it will be an easy question given that it is a multiple choice question?
Given that the two numbers appearing on throwing two dice are different, find the probability of the event 'the sum of numbers on the dice is 4'.

Consider the experiment of throwing a die. If a multiple of 3 comes up, throw the die again and if any other number comes, toss a coin. Find the conditional probability of the event 'the coin shows a tail', given that at least one die shows a 3.
If P(A) = 1/4 and P(B) = 1/2, find P(A ∩ B) if A and B are independent events.
Two cards are drawn at random and without replacement from a pack of 52 playing cards. Find the probability that both the cards are black.

A box of oranges is inspected by examining three randomly selected oranges drawn without replacement. If all the three oranges are good, the box is approved for sale; otherwise, it is rejected. Find the probability that a box containing 15 oranges out of which 12 are good and 3 are bad will be approved for sale.
A fair coin and an unbiased die are tossed. Let A be the event 'head appears on the coin' and B be the event '3 on the die'. Check whether A and B are independent events or not.
A die marked 1, 2, 3 in red and 4, 5, 6 in green is tossed. Let A be the event 'the number is even' and B be the event 'the number is red'. Are A and B independent?
Let E and F be events with P(E) = 2/5, P(F) = 3/10 and P(E ∩ F) = 1/10. Are E and F independent?
Given that the events A and B are such that P(A) = 3/5 and P(A ∪ B) = 3/5, and P(B) = p. Find p if they are (i) mutually exclusive (ii) independent.
Let A and B be independent events with P(A) = 0.3 and P(B) = 0.4. Find (i) P(A ∩ B), (ii) P(A ∪ B), (iii) P(A | B), (iv) P(B | A).
If A and B are two events such that P(A) = 1/4, P(B) = 1/2 and P(A ∩ B) = 1/8, find P(not A and not B).
Events A and B are such that P(A) = 1/2, P(B) = 1/4 and P(not A or not B) = 1/2. State whether A and B are independent.
Given two independent events A and B such that P(A) = 0.3, P(B) = 0.6. Find (i) P(A and B), (ii) P(A and not B), (iii) P(A or B), (iv) P(neither A nor B).
A die is tossed thrice. Find the probability of getting an odd number at least once.

Two balls are drawn at random with replacement from a box containing 10 black and red balls. Find the probability that (i) both balls are red, (ii) first ball is black and second is red, (iii) one of them is black and the other is red.

3-mark.question: A person has undertaken a construction job. The probabilities are 0.65 that there will be a strike, 0.80 that the job will be completed on time if there is no strike, and 0.32 that it will be completed on time if there is a strike. Determine the probability that the job will be completed on time.

Bag I contains 3 red and 4 black balls while Bag II contains 5 red and 6 black balls. One ball is drawn at random from one of the bags and it is found to be red. Find the probability that it was drawn from Bag II.

Given three identical boxes I, II and III, each containing two coins. Box I: two gold coins, Box II: two silver coins, Box III: one gold and one silver coin. A person chooses a box at random and takes out a gold coin. What is the probability that the other coin in the box is also gold?

Suppose the reliability of an HIV test is as follows: 90% of people having HIV are correctly detected, 10% go undetected. 99% of people without HIV are correctly tested negative, 1% are falsely positive. From a large population where only 0.1% have HIV, one person tests positive. What is the probability that the person actually has HIV?

In a factory manufacturing bolts, machines A, B, and C produce 25%, 35%, and 40% of the bolts. Of their outputs, 5%, 4%, and 2% respectively are defective. A randomly chosen bolt is defective. What is the probability it was manufactured by machine B?

A doctor may come by train, bus, scooter, or other means with probabilities 1/4, 1/3, 1/12, and the rest. He is late with probabilities 1/5, 1/4, 1/3 for train, bus, and scooter respectively, and on time if using other means. If he is late, what is the probability that he came by train?
A man speaks the truth 3 out of 4 times. He throws a die and reports that it is a six. Find the probability that it is actually a six.
An urn contains 5 red and 5 black balls. A ball is drawn, its colour is noted and replaced. Then, 2 more balls of the same colour are added. Find the probability that the second ball drawn is red.

Bag I contains 4 red and 4 black balls. Bag II contains 2 red and 6 black balls. One of the bags is selected at random and a red ball is drawn. Find the probability that the ball was drawn from Bag I.

In a college, 60% of the students reside in hostels and 40% are day scholars. 30% of hostellers and 20% of day scholars attain A grade. If a student selected at random has an A grade, what is the probability that the student is a hosteller?

A student answers a multiple choice question. Let p be the probability that he knows the answer and q be the probability that he guesses. If the answer is correct, what is the probability that the student knew the answer?

A laboratory blood test is 99% effective in detecting a certain disease when present, but gives a false positive result for 0.5% of healthy people. If 0.1% of the population has the disease, what is the probability that a person who tested positive actually has the disease?

There are three coins: one is a two-headed coin, one is a biased coin showing heads 75% of the time, and one is a fair coin. One of the coins is tossed and shows heads. What is the probability that it was the two-headed coin?

An insurance company insured 2000 scooter drivers, 4000 car drivers, and 6000 truck drivers. Accident probabilities are 0.01, 0.03, and 0.15 respectively. If an insured person meets with an accident, what is the probability that the person is a scooter driver?

A factory has two machines A and B. Machine A produces 60% of the items, B produces 40%. 2% of A's items and 1% of B's items are defective. A defective item is found. What is the probability that it was produced by machine B?

Two groups are competing for a board position. The first group has a 0.6 chance of winning, the second group 0.4. If the first group wins, the chance of introducing a new product is 0.7; otherwise, it is 0.3. What is the probability that a new product introduced was by the second group?

A girl throws a die. If she gets 5 or 6, she tosses a coin 3 times and notes the number of heads. If she gets 1 to 4, she tosses a coin once. If exactly one head is observed, find the probability that she threw 1 to 4 on the die.

A manufacturer has three machine operators A, B, and C. A produces 1% defective items, B 5%, and C 7%. Their working times are 50%, 30%, and 20% respectively. A defective item is found. What is the probability that it was produced by A?
A card from a pack of 52 cards is lost. From the remaining cards, two cards are drawn and both are diamonds. Find the probability that the lost card is a diamond.
